description:
You are a Farm and Home Management Educator consulting for a vegetable operation undergoing USDA Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) certification audit. The auditor arrives tomorrow. Using the farmOS Field Kit app, create the following 5 farm logs to document today's required GAP compliance activities. All logs must be completed today to satisfy the auditor's request for current-week records:

1. An Activity log named 'Worker hygiene training sign-in' at 6:30 AM (mark as Done) with notes: '7 field workers signed FSMA hygiene training attestation form HYG-2024-03. Portable sanitation units at field stations 1-3 confirmed clean, sanitizer restocked, handwashing water temp verified above 60F.'

2. An Input log named 'Irrigation well water E.coli sampling' at 8:00 AM (mark as Done) with notes: 'Collected well water sample per FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112. Sent to county lab, account W-2024-0142. Previous test: negative, collected 43 days ago. Sample ID: WS-20240314-001.'

3. An Activity log named 'Field harvest bin sanitation log' at 10:30 AM (mark as Done) with notes: '12 harvest bins cleaned and sanitized with 200 ppm sodium hypochlorite solution. Bins air-dried before use. Cold chain temperature log started at 34F. FSMA traceability lot code VEG-2024-0314 assigned.'

4. An Observation log named 'Field border wildlife intrusion check' at 1:00 PM (mark as NOT Done) with notes: 'Deer tracks found in NE corner adjacent to cattle operation. Evidence of wildlife intrusion in approximately 400 sq ft area. Produce from intrusion zone excluded from commercial harvest. Buffer flagged for re-inspection. Follow-up required.'

5. An Activity log named 'GAP audit records daily review' at 5:00 PM (mark as Done) with notes: 'Reviewed all paper records against GAP checklist version 3.2. Two spray application records from prior week had missing timestamps — corrected and initialed. All corrective actions documented. Records filed for auditor review tomorrow 8:00 AM.'
